successNotice.title: Your information was successfully saved in CanadaLogin
successNotice.body: Your verified information has been updated.

heading: Sign in to services to apply this update
description: Services connected with CanadaLogin only receive your updated information when you sign in again. Until you sign out and sign back in, the services below will keep showing your previous information.
servicesHeading: Services needing you to sign in again
servicesDescription: Be sure to save any active progress. If you choose to do this later, these services will keep showing your old information until you next sign out and sign back in to each one.
informationHeading: This update only applies to services connected through CanadaLogin.
informationBody: If you are trying to update your information with a service that is not connected to your CanadaLogin, you will need to go to that account.
